answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 6827 Country: India Title: Can we arrange the aqiqah in Walima ceremony of my brother it is right or wrong? Question: Can we arrange the aqiqah in Walima ceremony of my brother it is right or wrong? Answer ID: 6827 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 697/697=M/1429) If you slaughter an animal in the wedding of your brother, you can make intention of aqiqah in the same, there is nothing wrong. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
